commitResults.messageBody:
Tasks are lost when the app exits.

Save the current task list after add, mark, unmark, and delete so it can be loaded in a later increment.
Prevent malformed save data from being overwritten and roll back task changes when saving fails.
Store deadline dates as LocalDate, format them for display, and show the input prompt before reading a command.
Move the chatbot banner, prompt, messages, and error display into Ui so Nerrad can focus on command processing. This is the first incremental A-MoreOOP refactor and preserves existing behaviour.
Move task creation and task-number validation from Nerrad into Parser. This separates command interpretation from application flow while preserving existing validation messages and task behaviour.

Encapsulate the task collection and its add, remove, lookup, size, and completion-state operations in TaskList. This keeps Nerrad from manipulating the List directly while retaining safe persistence rollback.

Give Nerrad Ui, Parser, Storage, and TaskList fields, and make Storage encapsulate its save-file path. This completes the A-MoreOOP separation while retaining the existing loading and persistence behaviour.
Move Nerrad classes into application, UI, parser, storage, and task packages. This makes each responsibility explicit while keeping src/main/java as the source root.
Cover Parser task creation and task-number validation across valid inputs and all meaningful error categories, ensuring the parser's user-facing errors remain stable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand JUnit coverage for core logic
commitResults.messageBody: Add Storage and TaskList tests for persistence, task-list operations, and error handling. Document the requirement to maintain JUnit coverage for the highest-value methods after code changes.

Capitalise tag descriptions and add ending punctuation so the API documentation has a consistent, professional format.

The console test skill used the pre-package main class name.

Run the package-qualified Nerrad entry point so UI tests work after the package refactor.

The project needs reusable guidance for applying the SE-EDU Java conventions.

Future commits need reusable guidance for following the SE-EDU Git conventions.

Agents need explicit instructions to apply the project coding and Git standards consistently.

Add a find command that searches task descriptions, preserves list order, and reports missing keywords clearly.
